signatures.description: Confirmed artifact (S01E01-S06 audit, 2026-09-11): faster-whisper large-v3 repeatedly inserted 'Altyazı M.K.' ("Subtitle by M.K.") mid-sentence into unrelated dialogue across every checked episode. Classic subtitle-credit training-data contamination, the same family as Whisper's documented 'thanks for watching' hallucination. Evidence for this entry: 26 occurrences / 5 episodes, always mid-sentence, never explained by nearby audio content.

Turkish broadcaster (TRT) audio-description disclaimer. Lower weight than the credit pattern: this text is plausibly genuinely spoken by an announcer in some broadcasts, not purely hallucinated -- treat as suspect, not certain, pending audio confirmation.

faster-whisper large-v3's well-documented 'thanks for watching' hallucination family (this module's own docstring names it), Turkish form. Confirmed artifact (Love Is In The Air S01E01-E02 audit, 2026-09-17): 'Izlediginiz icin tesekkurler'/'...tesekkur ederim' appears mid-episode with no corresponding dialogue, at points acoustic evidence alone can't catch -- low no_speech_prob and compression_ratio, avg_logprob above the low-confidence threshold, and only 2-3 occurrences per episode (below the >=3 recurrence-heuristic gate). Leading vowel of 'Izlediginiz'/'izlediginiz' is deliberately left out of the pattern since Turkish dotted/dotless I casing is unreliable under Python's re.IGNORECASE; 'zlediginiz' alone is distinctive enough to avoid false positives.
